headlines.title: Americans missing in deadly flood disaster
headlines.description: The State Department tells NBC News that 90 Americans are among the hundreds still missing after deadly floods along the Nepal/China border. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: Judge blocks Trump’s Postal Service regulation on mail-in ballots
headlines.description: The judge said the regulation is most likely unlawful because the president can’t insert the federal government into elections without Congress’ approval.

headlines.title: CIA chief asked Russia not to share intel with Iran during visit to Moscow
headlines.description: CIA Director John Ratcliffe asked Russia’s top spy chief not to share intelligence that could be used against the U.S. with Iran. NBC News Senior National Security Correspondent Courtney Kube reports on what was discussed in that meeting.

headlines.title: Patient battles insurance over coverage for tumor removal
headlines.description: Patient battles insurance over coverage for tumor removal In our series “The Cost of Denial,” NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports on short-term insurance plans, which, unlike most other health plans, are not required to cover pre-existing conditions. If you have a story to share, email us at costofdenial@nbcuni.com

headlines.title: Trump orders Lake Ontario renamed ‘Lake America’
headlines.description: President Trump’s order to rename Lake Ontario comes amid the growing trade war between the U.S. and Canada. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: ‘Big questions’ and few easy answers for Fed chair at annual retreat
headlines.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the bank’s Jackson Hole retreat offers him a chance to outline an inflation strategy and boost his credibility.

headlines.title: Peter Cullen, known for voicing Optimus Prime, dies at 85
headlines.description: Actor Peter Cullen, who is best known for voicing Optimus Prime in the "Transformers" movies and television show, has died at 85.

headlines.title: Rockstar Games pulls back the curtain on ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ after leak
headlines.description: The company teamed up with Netflix to offer fans an extended look at Jason and Lucia’s life of crime in Vice City, days after a hack leaked material from the long-awaited game.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Jake Reiner says he hasn’t spoken to his brother as he opens up about grief
headlines.description: “I will never understand why this happened,” Jake Reiner told KABC-TV of Los Angeles about the murders of Rob Reiner and Michelle Singer Reiner. His brother has been charged in their deaths.
